target.targetDisambiguation: Two ESP32 serial devices were present. Runtime project/version and USB inventory distinguished the XiaoZhi target from another project; only the XiaoZhi device was flashed. Permanent USB identifiers and unrelated project details are omitted.

firmware.note: This validates reinstallation of an online build, not a version upgrade and not byte-for-byte installation of the official Release ZIP.

steps.action: Selected the identified XiaoZhi USB serial device in the native Chrome chooser.
steps.result: Port connected; no manual boot-button intervention was requested.

steps.action: Executed the real Console flash workflow.
steps.result: The UI displayed ota_0 partition writes; progress screenshots captured at 3% and 25%, with the 25% frame published.
固件烧录完成，设备正在重新启动。

steps.action: Read startup serial output after Chrome released the port.
steps.result: Project xiaozhi, application 2.6.0, expected lichuang-dev name present, network reconnect and activating → idle observed.

startupEvidence.rawLogHandling: Raw startup logs remain in a private external cache (directory 0700, file 0600); only this allowlisted summary is committed. No MAC, UUID, IP, Wi-Fi name/password, activation code or signed URL is copied to the repository.

nvs.limit: Automatic network reconnection supports configuration-retention behavior; this is not a bytewise NVS preservation test.
